summary: EscalaFácil backend end-to-end testing completed. All 19 pytest cases passed (100%). Verified auth flow (register/login/me with valid, missing, and invalid tokens), workplaces CRUD (create with full body, list, update with nested vacations, 404 on wrong id, delete + persistence via GET), shift overrides CRUD (create, list with year/month filter, upsert idempotency, delete), custom holidays CRUD (create/list/delete), and authorization boundary between two users (user2 cannot see/PUT/DELETE user1's workplace — all return 404 with data intact). No backend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py DELETE /api/shifts/{wid}/{date} always returns 204 even when no override exists for that (workplace, date). Not a bug per spec (idempotent delete) but worth noting — no ownership check on workplace_id is performed before deletion (query is scoped by user_id so cross-user access is safe).

server.py list_overrides uses regex ^YYYY-MM- for filtering; safe since year/month are ints, but if either is 0/None the branch is skipped and it returns ALL overrides for that workplace. Consider requiring both together or returning 400 when only one is provided.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded dev value if env var is missing. Fine for preview, but production should require it via os.environ['JWT_SECRET'].
@app.on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: Demo user (demo@escalafacil.com / demo123456) ensured; second user created with unique email each run for isolation test; all workplaces/shifts/holidays created within tests are cleaned up in fixtures/finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_escalafacil.py covers all EscalaFácil endpoints. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_escalafacil.py -v. Uses BACKEND_URL env or defaults to preview URL. Demo credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
